market.conclusion: This is a risk-off market, and tech is at its center. SPY and QQQ are both below their 50- and 200-day averages, only 10% of stocks are above their 50-day average, and fear is elevated (VIX 26.62). Defensive sectors such as staples, healthcare and utilities are leading, while technology trails badly, so short-term trades in tech names don't make sense yet.
arguments: Macro (against): tech downtrend, elevated fear, and credit spreads widening from 3.3 to 3.63. I give this the most weight because it hits almost every name on the list.
Technical (against): most names show lower highs and lower lows below their 50-day averages. I weigh this heavily for swing calls, because a cheap stock can keep falling for weeks.
Fundamental (for, in places): NVDA, NFLX and ORCL screen as good businesses at or below fair value. That matters for long-term buying, but not for timing.
Quant (neutral): no signal has been validated, and none of the 763 recorded forecasts has been scored yet. I give it no weight.
Trading conditions read RED, but that gauge is experimental. I treat it as background colour, not a rule.
market.change_mind: Closes above $733.39 on SPY and $649.66 on QQQ would turn me less defensive. The GDP and PCE inflation data on 2026-11-25 and the jobs report on 2026-12-04 are the next catalysts. A break below $623.40 on QQQ would confirm further downside.

deep_dive.case_for: It is a grade A business whose revenue grew 83.38% over the last year. At $155.38 it sits below the bottom of its value range ($191.49–$411.04), its forward P/E is 9.25, and analysts raised next-year earnings estimates by 4.34% over the past 30 days.
deep_dive.case_against: The stock fell 28.71% in 20 sessions and keeps making lower highs and lower lows. Its operating margin of 65% is at the top of its 5-year range, unpaid customer bills grew faster than sales, and insiders sold $946.6M outside pre-set plans. It also sits at the heart of the AI sell-off.
deep_dive.decides: For the long term, the business-and-price case is already strong, so build the position gradually instead of all at once. For a swing trade, a close above $171.33 would show the selling is over. A close below $147.14 would mean more pain first.
